resources.string: Turn a calendar event into a page people sign up on, on your own Mobilizon instance or Pretix server. Open an event in the Calendar tool and press Invite online. Nothing is sent until you press Sign in, Check or Publish.
mobilizon.fr, or your own instance\'s address
Used once to sign in, then forgotten. Only the sign-in tokens are kept.
With the email and password of your account on this instance
pretix.eu, or your own server\'s address
The organizer\'s short name, as in pretix.eu/<organizer>/
A team API token from the organizer\'s Teams page, from a team that can create events
Three letters, like EUR. Blank uses your region\'s. The ticket is free either way.
Asks the server for the organizer with this token
That isn\'t a web address %1$s can be reached at.
%1$s says this token can\'t reach that organizer.
